warnings.headline: Cancellation of Severe Thunderstorm Warning for South Interior forecast district
warnings.description:
This warning is now cancelled.
          
          Further severe thunderstorms are possible about far eastern parts of the state for the remainder of today. If they become likely, additional Severe Thunderstorm Warnings will be issued.
          
          51.2 MM WAS RECORDED AT GILES IN THE 15 MINUTES TO 12:44 PM.
